reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The Cilium cluster name is now validated to consist of at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and '-', start and end with an alphanumeric character", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Cluster names that do not consist of at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and '-', or do not start and end with an alphanumeric character, will be rejected during installation/upgrade unless upgradeCompatibility is set to v1.15 or earlier; strict validation will be enforced in Cilium v1.17.
consequence.remediation: Ensure the cluster name conforms to the validation rules (max 32 chars, lowercase alphanumeric and '-' only, start/end with alphanumeric), or temporarily set upgradeCompatibility to v1.15 or earlier as a workaround.

proposed.statement: Cilium 1.16.0 introduces validation of the cluster name to require at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and hyphens, starting and ending with alphanumeric characters; this can be temporarily bypassed with upgradeCompatibility set to v1.15 or earlier, but will be strictly enforced in v1.17.
